builder_plan.scenario: Your workload might fit a smaller or differently structured model.
builder_plan.change: Check for available weights and a compatible runtime before planning a product trial.
builder_plan.baseline: Your current model on identical held-out tasks and the same resource budget.
steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.
Save a small set of representative product tasks and expected outcomes. Keep evaluation tasks out of any training or tuning, and choose quality and cost limits before running.
Run the baseline and the proposed change on identical inputs. Keep other settings fixed and repeat paired runs to expose variation.
Save per-task outputs, failures, timings, and all usage costs. Review regressions before expanding the test.
builder_plan.measure: Task success, latency, memory, context limits, and migration cost.
builder_plan.decision: Keep the change only if it meets your preselected quality and latency limits and improves the metric you care about after setup and operating costs. Otherwise retain the baseline. This is an exploration plan, not a validated recommendation.

title: Towards Reliable, Scalable, and Value-Aligned Generative Recommendation for Large-Scale Advertising
summary: GR4AD-X replaces deterministic semantic-ID assignment and likelihood-only beam search with multi-path SID construction, multi-dimensional capacity scaling, and unified value-guided generation, beam pruning, and discriminative reranking. It costs additional training complexity, prefix-level reward modeling, reranking computation, and tighter coupling between generation quality and commercial-value estimation. It can fail if value rewards are misspecified, if prefix-level credit assignment remains weak, or if the gains depend on Kuaishou-scale traffic, data, and serving infrastructure that a small team cannot reproduce.
rationale: This is relevant to production recommendation and advertising systems, but its benefits are demonstrated at large industrial scale and depend on infrastructure, data volume, and online experimentation capacity beyond the reader's constrained setting.
technique: Value-aligned generative recommendation with semantic IDs

claims.statement: GR4AD-X replaces deterministic semantic-ID assignment and likelihood-only beam search with multi-path SID construction, multi-dimensional capacity scaling, and unified value-guided generation, beam pruning, and discriminative reranking. It costs additional training complexity, prefix-level reward modeling, reranking computation, and tighter coupling between generation quality and commercial-value estimation. It can fail if value rewards are misspecified, if prefix-level credit assignment remains weak, or if the gains depend on Kuaishou-scale traffic, data, and serving infrastructure that a small team cannot reproduce.

Cumulative revenue improvement of 3.07% over the deployed GR4AD baseline in large-scale online A/B tests on the Kuaishou advertising platform, while satisfying strict latency and throughput constraints.
